descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S26 「现成 spec：每个 ai.* action 拒绝匿名调用（api/actions.spec.ts，在这个 build 上加载不了）」 Existing spec: every ai.* action refuses an anonymous caller (api/actions.spec.ts, does not load on this build)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3a Speech-to-text runs through a BAA-covered, authenticated path, not a direct, unauthenticated call: routed server-side, with no API key in the browser.（UAT OAT-05 step 3；TFA-94423 AC 1）
  • T3 Every AI call, including Ask AI and Handoff, goes out from server-side Convex actions with the Bedrock guardrail applied.（TFA-92568 AC 13；TFA-92568 Eng 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Tim's api fixtures on the local stack, with no session token

When Call every ai.* action, transcription included, as an anonymous caller

Then Every call is refused before any provider is contacted

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 3 'not a direct, unauthenticated call' and TFA-92568 AC 13 (calls go out from server-side Convex actions, for signed-in callers). The Playwright assertion is the verdict. Blocked, not Fail, while the spec does not load: that is the harness, not the app.

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-a。

UAT item: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-05/S26

Existing spec: every ai.* action refuses an anonymous caller (api/actions.spec.ts, does not load on this build)

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Our own api spec that does not depend on the broken ARGS registry: declaredActions() from source, valid args from ARGS plus our own entry for any action ARGS misses (voicefix.extractPatientDetails), each called with no Authorization header; every call must be refused with 'Not authenticated' (a validator refusal proves nothing and fails the case). — Deterministic, no model call can happen for an anonymous caller (requireUserId runs first).

Detail:

Our own spec (no dependency on the broken ARGS registry): 26 actions declared in convex/ai, all 26 refused for a caller with no session, every refusal 'ConvexError: Not authenticated at requireUserId (convex/lib/auth.ts) at handler (convex/lib/phi.ts)', i.e. before any provider; transcribe.transcribeAudio and transcribe.prepareSession included; voicefix.extractPatientDetails called with our own args.

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/actions.spec.ts): it calls every ai.* action anonymously through e2e/support/backend.ts on the local stack; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
